investigations.headline: 2026 Honda Pilot: 11 owners report the steering wheel clicking when turned, often blamed on the clock spring (cable reel). Dealer replacements are not fixing it. It looks like a noise defect, and no airbag or control failure has been reported.

theme.name: Steering wheel clunks or clicks when turning

investigations.headline: 2025 Toyota Tacoma: interior door handle assemblies break in normal use at low mileage, so occupants cannot open the door from inside. Replacement parts are reported on national backorder and no recall covers the problem.

reading.label: Consistent failure pattern in owner complaints

theme.name: Rear door latch fails to open or close

investigations.headline: 2024 Jeep Wrangler 4xe: two separate loss-of-power problems. The October 2025 over-the-air update shutdowns are already recalled under 25V710000. A second pattern is not covered by any recall: since the 68C battery recall software (25V741000), owners report electric drive power dropping, then a delay of several seconds before the gas engine takes over.

reading.label: Consistent failure pattern in owner complaints

theme.name: Vehicle suddenly loses engine power at speed
